# Support

Thanks for trying Serein Translate — this document points you to the right channel.

## Questions and help

- [GitHub Discussions](../../discussions) for setup questions (LTEngine build, GPU/model
  selection) and usage help.
- Translation-layer bugs: open a [bug report](../../issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- Client crashes: open a [crash report](../../issues/new?template=crash_report.yml).
- Feature ideas: open a [feature request](../../issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).

## Scope

- This fork carries the on-device translation layer. Client bugs unrelated to translation
  are best reported upstream at [ViceVerse-cz/Serein](https://github.com/ViceVerse-cz/Serein).
- Security issues must not go through public issues — see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
Never post tokens, passwords, QR images, MFA codes, private histories or raw captures
anywhere in this repository.
